title: Pickles – the dog who found the World Cup

scenes.text: A dog saved the World Cup.
March 1966. Four months before the World Cup in England, the trophy is on display at an exhibition in London.
Then one Sunday... it's gone. Stolen. In broad daylight.
England is in shock. The newspapers go crazy. Then the head of the FA gets a ransom note. £15,000... or the trophy is gone forever.
Police catch a man at the handover. But the trophy? Still missing.
One week later, a man called David Corbett takes his dog for a walk in South London. The dog's name... is Pickles.
Pickles starts sniffing at a hedge. There's a package, wrapped in newspaper.
David opens it... and finds the World Cup!
Four months later, England win the World Cup at Wembley.
And Pickles? He gets a medal, a movie role... and an invitation to the team's celebration party.
The greatest hero of the 1966 World Cup... might have been a dog. Follow for more football stories.
